blocks.text: Shown 2026-08-25, and the answer is stronger than "already configured". The next session in the series captured cprrp1220m000's full option set, where Update Pegging Relations is selected _and_ read-only — the source on file. Its help states "You can modify this check box only if the `Update Pegging Relations during Order Planning` field in the Scenarios (cprpd4100m000) session is `User Specified`", so the disabled state means the ACT scenario is not set to User Specified and pegging relations are rebuilt on every run regardless of operator intent. Nobody on the 2026-08-20 call could have turned it off, which is why the tree resolved without the prerequisite being discussed. See planned-order-transfer-training_2026-08-25.md §3.5.

That does not make them a substitute for help text — a screenshot shows a value and never tells you what it means (§2.2) — but it does mean the export list can now be written from observed field names rather than guesses.

sessions.text: The split runs along module lines. Session help is filed for every Common, Sales and Warehousing session above — tcibd0501m100, tcibd2100m000, tcibd0102m000, tdsls4100m900, whwmd4300m000 — and for three Enterprise Planning sessions: cprrp0520m000, cprrp1100m000, cprrp1220m000. The other eight EP sessions have none, including every session under the cprpd and cprmp prefixes. Those eight are named here from the vendor guide or read off the status bar.
